checklist.notes: The language and task demands in the B1-U05-L02 EXERCISE_SET are broadly appropriate for its declared CEFR tier.
No material English grammar, lexical, pronunciation-description, or meaning error was found in the reviewed B1-U05-L02 EXERCISE_SET.
The reviewed B1-U05-L02 EXERCISE_SET remains within its declared lesson references and communicative scope.

findings.description: The rubric requires evidence that the answer representation does not supply, making the linking criterion impossible to score consistently from the key.
findings.recommendation: Add the exact required boundary marking to keyed variants or remove visual marking from the scoring requirement and define an audio-only criterion.

limitations: This review covers only the immutable B1-U05-L02 EXERCISE_SET and its fresh static machine-report context. It does not assess human or release approval, provider authentication, live-provider behavior, learner outcomes, or Internet-wide originality.
